ambient: They show you another thing, quickly, before there's no time.
Something is decided about you and everyone is pleased.
The pace picks up. They're trying to fit it all in.
description: There are things here and they're delighted. Not menacing. Delighted, and busy, and in the middle of showing you something enormous at a speed you can't follow. They know you. You have the strong sense that you knew them, before, and agreed to this.
name: The Ones Who Were Expecting You

looks: They have too many parts and all of them are being used well.
One of them checks you're keeping up and carries on regardless.
objects.name: the ones here

looks: Enormous, obvious, and going past far too fast.
You understand it perfectly and won't be permitted to keep it.
It's about you, mostly, and you aren't the important part.
objects.name: what they're showing you

weather: It's warm here, and the warmth is coming from the activity rather than from anywhere.
